drawings.description: dans le texte dactylographié, après « such as », deux figures tracées à la main : un triangle dont les trois sommets sont marqués d'un point, puis, après « or », un cercle portant deux points diamétralement opposés ; suivent les mots « which are circles ».
drawings.kind: two cell decompositions of the circle (triangle; circle with two points)
drawings.notes: A triangle with a point at each of its three vertices, and, after the handwritten word or, a closed curve (a flattened circle) with two marked points at the two ends of its horizontal diameter: two amalgamated sums of 1-cells that are circles. The three sides of the triangle are drawn between the same three computed vertices (on the page the right side starts just short of the top vertex); the circle is drawn as an ellipse through its two marked points. The typed words around the figures and the handwritten or are not drawn. The page is only summarised in the transcription (duplicate typescript); the mark follows the summary. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
